svg.title: Ynys Prydain a Chymru
svg.desc: Map of the island of Britain with borders for Wales (Cymru), England (Lloegr) and Scotland (Yr Alban); Ireland (Iwerddon) across the sea to the west, Brittany (Llydaw) across the sea to the south and the European mainland (Ewrop) to the south-east. An enlarged inset of Wales shows the mountains of Eryri with Yr Wyddfa, the river Severn (Hafren) running from mid Wales through England to the sea, the river Usk (Wysg) with the walled city of Caerllion, the island of Anglesey (Ynys Môn) off Eryri, the town of Carmarthen (Caerfyrddin) in the south-west, and a small dot for Cwm Helyg among small mountains in south Wales. The main map also marks the city of London (Llundain) in England.
